entries.2a8144ba187142c0: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary KOA SHOJI Co., Ltd., which imports pharmaceutical raw materials, active pharmaceutical ingredients, from overseas and sells them to pharmaceutical companies, mainly generic drug manufacturers. entries.3911f3f1dbd7a226: Although it is a trading company that imports and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, it has its own analytical capabilities, and in addition to providing existing products stably, it offers proposals and support from its customers' research and development stages, as well as quality improvement proposals and technical provision of new manufacturing methods to active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturers. A further feature is that it has a system enabling integrated manufacturing from active pharmaceutical ingredients through to formulations. In the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Sales Business, it has production facilities for highly pharmacologically active injectables, which require advanced technology and large investment.
